definitions.collected: มูลฝอยที่จัดเก็บได้ — general municipal solid waste collected by each district office (สำนักงานเขต) and delivered to BMA transfer/disposal facilities, weighed at the facilities. Not generation: excludes waste recycled or sold at source, waste not collected, hazardous and infectious waste (separate BMA series).
definitions.others: Row 'อื่นๆ' (Others) in the BMA tables: waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices (in env0004 the column is 'envidepart_ton', i.e. collected by the Environment Department itself). It cannot be allocated to districts; the citywide total includes it.
definitions.disposed: มูลฝอยที่นำไปกำจัด — tonnage received for disposal by technology (env0011).

daysDivisorPolicy: BMA Environment Department PDFs (FY2562–FY2569): tonnesPerDay = fiscal-year total ÷ number of days stated in the table header ('รวม N วัน', 365 or 366 = calendar days of 1 Oct–30 Sep); reproduces the publisher's own average column. Legacy CSV (BE 2553–2561): annual ÷ 365, the divisor the publisher used in its own per-day columns.
yearConvention: year = Gregorian year in which the Thai fiscal year ends (FY BE 2569 = 1 Oct 2025 – 30 Sep 2026 → 2026).

series.nameEn: Collected waste by district office, fiscal years (BMA Environment Department annual PDFs)
series.quality: Each row passes 12-month-sum = annual-total check; 51 rows sum to the published grand total; row order verified against printed row numbers.

series.nameEn: Solid waste by district BE 2553–2561 (data.go.th garbage1/garbage)
series.definition: collected (ปริมาณขยะมูลฝอย; the dataset title does not say collected/generated — values reconcile with BMA collected totals to within ~1%)
series.quality: Several columns misaligned (sorted) and cells inconsistent; flagged values are null with status 'unavailable', raw values retained in rawPublished.
